english.title: Driver of a goods vehicle fail to produce a plating certificate after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person

(A)_[driving a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on a road, namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) on being required by a constable, failed to produce for examination a plating certificate issued in respect of the vehicle and any trailer drawn by it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For failure merely to give name and address see offence wordings H39, H49 and H881.
(ii) For failure to give name and address and produce documents after accident/suspected offence see offence wording H324, H325, H326, H327, H328, H329, H330, H331, H332, H333, H334 and H335.
(iii) For failure to produce insurance certificate and plating/test certificate after accident/suspected offence see offence wording H3125, H3126, H3127 and H3128.
(iv) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offences in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to produce for examination by a police constable a plating certificate in respect of

(D)_[the vehicle]_
(E)_[a trailer drawn by the vehicle]_
(F)_[the vehicle and a trailer drawn by it]_

when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd nwyddau yn methu cyflwyno tystysgrif blatio ar ôl trosedd/damwain ar y ffordd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd yn gyrru cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), pan ofynnodd gwnstabl i chi wneud hynny, bu i chi fethu cyflwyno, ar gyfer ei harchwilio, dystysgrif blatio a roddwyd yng nghyswllt y cerbyd ac unrhyw drelar a oedd yn cael ei dynnu ganddo
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[dan amheuaeth o fod yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Methodd y diffynnydd gyflwyno, ar gyfer ei harchwilio gan gwnstabl, dystysgrif blatio ar gyfer

(D)_[y cerbyd]_
(E)_[trelar a oedd yn cael ei dynnu gan y cerbyd]_
(F)_[y cerbyd a threlar a oedd yn cael ei dynnu ganddo]_

pan ofynnwyd iddo wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu cyn pen saith diwrnod.
